summary.text: Brian Lenney is a Republican Idaho state senator who has represented District 13 since December 2022 and is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026.
A consultant and former columnist, he succeeded Jeff Agenbroad in the seat.

paragraphs.text: Brian Lenney was born in Corona, California, and earned an associate degree from Riverside Community College in 2002, a bachelor's degree from the University of North Dakota in 2007, and a graduate degree from Biola University in 2010.
His career experience includes working as a self-employed copywriter and consultant, a marketing manager with Millionaire Publishing, and a columnist with Townhall Media.
He assumed office in the Idaho State Senate on December 1, 2022, and advanced from the Republican primary on May 19, 2026.
In a 2022 Ballotpedia survey, Lenney said he and his wife moved to Nampa, Idaho, in 2010, that they homeschool their four children, and that he is focused on individual liberty.
He listed medical freedom, school choice and permanent tax relief as his three key campaign messages.
